An '''unidentified officer''' served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he worked for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] aboard the ''[[Razor's Kiss]]''.
